speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for sharing your history. To better understand your gait and limb ataxia, have you noticed any tremors or muscle weakness in your limbs, and how long have these symptoms been progressing?

speaker: Patient
text: I started having trouble walking recently, and people say I look drunk when I walk. I also feel clumsy in my arms and legs, especially on the right side.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for that description. Have you experienced any issues with your vision, such as double vision or blurred sight, and do you notice any changes in your speech or swallowing difficulties? Additionally, have you had any recent falls or injuries due to this instability?

speaker: Patient
text: I have Crohn disease and it has been difficult to control. I have been taking natalizumab for about a year.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy (PML) secondary to natalizumab therapy. Given your history of Crohn's disease treated with natalizumab and the onset of ataxia, I suspect JC virus reactivation in the brain.

REQUEST TEST: MRI Brain with and without contrast.
REQUEST IMAGES.
